title: Vault 00: Calibration
description: Initial sync trials. Baseline signal integrity check before deeper containment sectors unlock.

problems.title: Signal Check
problems.statementMarkdown:
A containment relay emits a pulse that feeds back into itself. The first pulse registers a strength of **1**.

Every subsequent pulse obeys the growth law:

$$f(n) = 3f(n-1) + 2$$

The containment field fails the moment a pulse exceeds **1000**.

Determine the index $n$ of the first pulse that breaches the field.
hints: Compute the first few pulses by hand — the sequence climbs fast.
Watch the boundary: you need the first pulse strictly greater than 1000, not equal to it.

problems.title: Broken Relay
problems.statementMarkdown:
A three-state relay cycles in a fixed loop:

$$S_0 \rightarrow S_1 \rightarrow S_2 \rightarrow S_0$$

The relay advances one step for every divisor of $60$ — including the trivial ones.

Starting from state $S_0$, which state is the relay in after all divisors have been processed?
hints: Count every divisor of 60, including 1 and 60 themselves.
Only the count modulo 3 matters — the relay loops with period 3.

problems.title: Core Alignment
problems.statementMarkdown:
The calibration core demands an alignment key before it will accept new geometry.

The key is the number of trailing zeros in the decimal expansion of $100!$ (one hundred factorial).

Transmit the key as a plain integer.
hints: Trailing zeros come from factors of 10 — each one needs both a 2 and a 5.
Twos are plentiful. Count how many times factor 5 divides into 100! (don't forget higher powers of 5).
